title: Selection Group
description: UI selection group component for menu navigation and item selection.
content:
Selection Group

UI selection group component for managing menu navigation and selectable item groups.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"selectionGroup": {
  "defaultIndex": 0,
  "wrap": true,
  "orientation": "..."
}

Description

The SelectionGroup component manages groups of selectable UI items for menu navigation. It handles directional navigation between items, tracks the currently selected index, and supports input-driven selection changes. This component is essential for building navigable menus, option lists, and any UI that requires cycling through selectable items.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
defaultIndexintThe index of the item selected by default when the group is displayed.
wrapboolWhether navigation wraps around from the last item to the first.
orientationstringNavigation axis for the group ("horizontal" or "vertical").

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "selectionGroup": {
      "defaultIndex": 0,
      "wrap": true,
      "orientation": "vertical"
    }
  }
}
